source_excerpts.text:
## A. An affine lift of a supplied transported density

Let K(t) be a C1 real symmetric d by d matrix on an interval. Write
x=(q,v,W) in R^(2d+1), and set

    B = [[0,I,0],[-K,0,0],[0,0,0]],
    M = [[K,0,0],[K',K,0],[0,0,0]].

On (t,x), use the torsion-free affine connection whose only nonzero
coefficients are Gamma^i_00=(Mx)^i for spatial i. Let mu be a supplied C1
nonnegative density satisfying

    partial_t mu + (Bx).grad_x mu = 0.

Then V=(1,Bx) is geodesic, A=mu V tensor V is positive semidefinite as a
contravariant quadratic form and div_nabla A=0. For constant Lambda>=0,
b=Lambda W^2/2 has H_nabla b=Lambda dW tensor dW and A:H_nabla b=0.

Proof. Direct block multiplication gives B'+B^2=-M and tr B=0. Thus
(V.grad)V=(0,(B'+B^2)x) and the connection adds (0,Mx), proving
nabla_V V=0. The coordinate connection trace Gamma^a_ab vanishes: the only
possible nonzero symbols have two lower time indices and spatial upper index.
Consequently div_nabla V=tr B=0. The tensor product rule gives

    div_nabla(mu V tensor V)
      = [V(mu)+mu div_nabla V] V + mu nabla_V V = 0.

Positivity is A(alpha,alpha)=mu [alpha(V)]^2>=0 for every real covector alpha;
this is not a Lorentzian metric positivity assertion. The W row of M is zero,
so the connection correction to the coordinate Hessian of b vanishes. The
ordinary Hessian is Lambda dW tensor dW; V(W)=0 proves zero pairing.
For the associated flow q'=v, v'=-Kq,
U'=(q^T Kq-|v|^2)/2, differentiating W=U+q.v/2 also gives W'=0.

Scope. No construction of mu from a quantum field is proved here. This is the
auxiliary affine connection, not the physical Brinkmann Levi-Civita connection.
It supplies no Monge-Ampere existence theorem, boundary energy identity,
physical projection, sharp local smoothing, measurement or device.

## 2. A coherent current and an exactly passive background

The associated classical flow is
\[
q'=v,\qquad v'=-Kq,\qquad
U'=\frac12(q^TKq-|v|^2).
\]
Consequently
\[
\boxed{W=U+\frac12q\cdot v}
\]
is exactly conserved.

Propagating the field and its analyzing window by the same quadratic Schrödinger evolution gives an exact coherent transform. After unitary dilations, **all positive-frequency amplitudes evolve in one common Hilbert space**. They are summed before applying the positive quadratic form that produces the density.

For a positive transported window operator \(\Gamma_t\), the resulting density is
\[
\mu(t,W,q,v)
=\langle \mathcal F(t,W,q,v),\Gamma_t\mathcal F(t,W,q,v)\rangle,
\]
where \(\mathcal F\) contains the full frequency integral. Thus the construction retains the off-diagonal frequency interference. It satisfies
\[
\partial_t\mu+v\cdot\nabla_q\mu-Kq\cdot\nabla_v\mu=0.
\]

On the enlarged spatial base
\[
x=(q,v,W)\in\mathbb R^{2d+1},
\]
define
\[
B(t)=
\begin{pmatrix}
0&I&0\\
-K&0&0\\
0&0&0
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
M(t)=
\begin{pmatrix}
K&0&0\\
K'&K&0\\
0&0&0
\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Then
\[
B'+B^2=-M,\qquad \operatorname{tr}B=0.
\]

The lift uses the explicitly constructed torsion-free affine connection
\[
\Gamma^i_{00}=(Mx)^i,
\]
with other coefficients zero. For
\[
V=(1,Bx)=(1,v,-Kq,0),
\]
we have \(\nabla_VV=0\). Therefore
\[
\boxed{
A=\mu\,V\otimes V\ge0,
\qquad
\operatorname{div}_\nabla A=0.
}
\]

This connection is curved:
\[
R^i{}_{0j0}=M^i{}_j.
\]
It is the connection used by the auxiliary energy; it is distinguished throughout the proofs from the physical spacetime’s Levi-Civita connection.

The passive background is also constructed:
\[
\boxed{
b=\frac{\Lambda}{2}W^2,\qquad
H_\nabla b=\Lambda\,dW\otimes dW,\qquad
A:H_\nabla b=0.
}
\]

The density still depends on \(W\), carrying null-frequency interference. Passivity means that the current direction annihilates the background Hessian. It does not require discarding that dependence.
